name: appner
description: Unified IoT Data & Intelligence Platform. Ask about your Appner fleet: device state, offline devices, telemetry history, geofences and alerts. Connects to your Appner company account over MCP with OAuth sign-in.

fleet.content: Give me an overview of my Appner fleet: total devices, how many are online and offline, parser errors, SIM issues, and the devices that need attention. Use the appner-fleet-overview skill and name devices by their names, not ids.

offline.content: List my Appner devices that stopped reporting, most urgent first, with each device's name and when it was last seen. Use the appner-problem-devices skill. If I gave a time window, use it: $ARGUMENTS

where.content: Where is this Appner device right now, and how fresh is that position? Resolve it by name, IMEI or serial number and use the appner-device-location skill. Device: $ARGUMENTS
where.description: Last known location of a device
